title: R- vs H-Stacking Order Determination of MoTe2/WSe2 Heterobilayers Using STEM Atomic Resolution Imaging
content: Since the discovery of strongly correlated electronic phases such as superconductivity in magic angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG), extensive research has been conducted into moiré superlattices of 2D materials [1]. Moiré superlattices have captured the interest of many researchers due to their unique twist angle and stacking order sensitivity that change their electronic properties [2]. Researchers have studied this phenomenon across many different 2D materials and stimuli; however, it is key to accurately determine the twist angle in which these exotic phases emerge.
